atoms.name: Objective and geometry
atoms.one_line: Minimise within-cluster sum of squares; with Euclidean distance each cluster is a convex Voronoi cell.

atoms.name: Assignment step
atoms.one_line: Each point goes to the nearest centroid (compare squared distances).

atoms.name: Update step and convergence
atoms.one_line: Centroid becomes the mean; SSE never increases; ends at a local optimum that depends on the start.

atoms.name: k-medoid
atoms.one_line: Centres are actual data points; minimise total dissimilarity; works with any distance; robust to outliers.

atoms.name: Properties and choosing k
atoms.one_line: WSS falls as $k$ grows and hits 0 at $k=n$; use the elbow; $k$ is fixed in advance.
